takes/15_patienta.mp3.txt: Doc, why do my blackheads keep coming back after a peel-off mask?

takes/15_patientb.mp3.txt: Doc, why do my blackheads keep coming back after a peel-off mask?

takes/16_doctora.mp3.txt: A peel-off mask only pulls off the top of the plug. The oil deeper in the pour stays, so it fills right back up. Try a salicylic acid cleanser or serum a few times a week. It gets inside the pour and dissolves the oil. Give it a few weeks and don't squeeze them.
